question: Where can I find café within a 170 kilometers radius while heading from Wagner Hotel, New York, NY toward Johnsonburg Swamp Preserve, Johnsonburg, NJ?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Wagner Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Johnsonburg Swamp Preserve%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Johnsonburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), search_corridor AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(s.geometry::geometry, e.geometry::geometry)::geography, 170000) AS buffered_line, ST_MakeLine(s.geometry::geometry, e.geometry::geometry)::geography AS path_line FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.id, p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, search_corridor sc WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, sc.buffered_line) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sc.path_line) ASC;

answers.poi_name: Choc O Pain French Bakery and Café
